denominator_definition: the union of the enumerated sources; every retained claim is assigned to exactly one feature and every excluded claim carries a reason
open_residue: PRASA production wells: EPA SDWIS lists them without coordinates; PRASA's public facility layer places 260 wells, but it is a May 2020 snapshot and publishes no SDWIS id, so the two are linked only by name (candidates, never merges)
PRASA facility layer: the public ArcGIS copy is dated May 2020; facilities built, retired or renamed since then are not reflected
drinking-water treatment plants: EPA SDWIS lists them without coordinates; only PRASA's own plants are placed
wetlands: the National Wetlands Inventory mapping for Puerto Rico is largely from 1980s imagery
irrigation canals: the Junta de Planificación canal layer (sige.pr.gov) is unreachable from the build environment; NHD canal/ditch reaches stand in at coarser detail
Gobierno de PR geoserver (geoserver2.pr.gov, workspace pr_geodata) with PRASA and DRNA layers: connection reset from the build environment
DRNA water-franchise registry of permitted wells: no public registry found
DRNA and Junta de Planificación aquifer layers: sige.pr.gov and gis.otg.pr.gov unreachable from the build environment
names of the HA 730-N alluvial-valley polygons: the release labels them only by class
springs known only from speleological or local records: GNIS names 2 springs in Puerto Rico and USGS monitors 221; no public spring registry was found
intakes: EPA SDWIS lists its intake facilities without coordinates; PRASA's 2020 layer places 138 PRASA intakes, linked to SDWIS only by name
stream gauges are attributed to watersheds by location; their reach on the stream network is not computed (that needs network navigation, not distance)
DRNA reservoir and embalse lists: sige.pr.gov unreachable from the build environment
